t: Mi sheyyashen badderek vechoshka lo qoneh alpayim amma lekol ruach
s: Mi sheyyashen badderek vechoshka lo qoneh alpayim amma lekol ruach ubo b' seipim: kol adam qoneh shebita bemaqom sheqqiddesh alayv hayyom, veyesh lo mishsham alpayim lekol ruach, ap al pi shello amar "shebitati bimqomi", shekkevan sheim haya rotzeh haya omer — hare zeh kemo sheamar. Vaapillu mi sheyyashen badderek vechoshka lo — qana shebita bimqomo im hu chutz litchum hair, veyesh lo mishsham alpayim lekol ruach ap al pi shello nitkavven liqnot shebita kelal, shehoil veim haya neor haya qoneh — qoneh gam ken keshehu yashen. Vekol chapatzayv kamohu. Abal cheptze hepqer, sheen lahem bealim sheyyukelu lehaqnot lahem shebita — lo qanu shebita mealehem, ella hare hem keragle hazzokeh bahem techilla, sheyyakol leholikam lemaqom sheyyelek hu, vaapillu chutz litchum hair im ereb lesham. Abal cheptze hannokri qonim shebita bimqoman, ap al pi shebbaalehem lav bene shebita hem, sheggazeru al cheptze hannokri gezera mishshum cheptze yisrael, veim hotziam hannokri chutz lattechum — en lahem ella d' ammot. Ella sheim hebiam lair — dinam kemo shehotziuhu nokrim chutz lattechum unetanuhu bair, shekkol hair nechshebet lo ked' ammot, hoil veyatza beones, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"h. Vehu shettehe hair muqqepet mechitztzot ledira, shekkol maqom sheeno muqqap ledira eno nechshab ked' ammot, kemo shennitbaer besimman shtz"v. (Veeno domeh leshabat beir, shekkullah nechshebet lo ked' ammot ap al pi sheenah muqqepet mechitztzot kelal, lepi sheen matchilin limdod lo alpayim ella mibbayit hachitzon, hoil vekol batte hair mublaim zeh betok a' veshirayim shel zeh. Abal mikkol maqom en kol hair nechshebet lo ked' ammot mammash, ella beto sheqqana bo shebita bilbad, ushear habbattim hem mublaim zeh betok a' amma veshirayim shel zeh, veen matchilin hammedida mehem. Abal leyotze chutz lattechum en kol hair nechshebet ked' ammot ad shettehe muqqepet mechitztzot ledira). Usetam ayarot muqqapot ledira, shebbonim battim techilla veachar kak maqqipim otam. Abal setam mibtzarim enan muqqapim ledira:

Velaken yesh lizzaher sheyyisrael shehishil kelayv lenokri vehecheziram lo beshabbat, shello letaltelam bair chutz ld' ammot mehammaqom shehinnicham sham hannokri im en hair muqqepet mechitztzot, kegon im tiltelam echad b' ammot — lo yetaltelem hashsheni yoter mib' ammot. Abal im hinnicham bechatzer muttar letaltelam bekullah, shekkulla ked' ammot. Veken meboot shellanu hammetuqqanim betzurat petach niqraim muqqapim ledira, shehare bonim battim techilla veachar kak osim tzurat petach (vehu haddin im metuqqanim belechi o qora, shehem ked' ammot leinyan yotze chutz lattechum kemo shehem ked' ammot leinyan tiltul, shemmuttar letaltel bekullam):
